title: Pull Shot Back Foot Power (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 136bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Now here comes the short one son
Get inside the line, get on top of it
Dont flinch

[Verse 1]
Bowler delivers short and on the body
Back foot rocks back across the crease
Inside the line of the ball, body position
Top of the bounce timing, find your peace

Bat swings horizontal, high to low
Full rotation of the forearms through the follow
Top hand leading, bottom hand drives through
Pull to mid-wicket or to square leg, your two

[Pre-Chorus]
Inside the line, back and across
Top of the bounce, no toss-up and loss
Horizontal bat, full arm through
Pull shot power, that is what you do

[Chorus]
Pull shot back foot, inside the line
Top of the bounce, timing divine
Full arm rotation, bat horizontal through
Pull shot power, mid-wicket for two

[Verse 2]
Against the genuine quick, tuck or leave
Never pull from in front of your eyes or you will grieve
Inside the line and on top is the rule
Against the short ball, back foot is the school

[Bridge]
Bluey: He has rocked back, pulled, FOUR, magnificent pull shot
Trevor: His head position inside the line was the key, never at risk
Chas: I say I say, I have been throwing short balls at that boy since he was eight years old

[Chorus]
Pull shot back foot, inside the line
Top of the bounce, timing divine
Full arm rotation, bat horizontal through
Pull shot power, mid-wicket for two

[Outro]
Inside the line son
Always inside
Thats my boy
